minutes.headline: Planning Board approved 339 Electric Ave sign and facade 3-2; Highfield open-space shortfall sent to zoning officer.
minutes.summary: The board heard three applications. It approved sign and facade modifications for 339 Electric Avenue on a split vote after a contentious debate over building character. Unitil's 357 Electric Avenue site plan was continued to March 14 pending petrol barrier details. Highfield Village was continued to March 28 after the open space was found not to meet the cluster bylaw.

public_comment.topic: Asked whether a retention pond could improve stormwater treatment at the Unitil site.
Concern about future development on lots next to his land at Highfield Village.
Asked that the pump station reference be removed from the Highfield sewer plan.
Traffic safety on Route 13 and request for a traffic light or four-way stop.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the signs at 339 Electric Avenue, then approved the building facade there on a 3-2 split vote.
The Unitil 357 Electric Avenue site plan hearing was continued to March 14, with petrol barrier manufacturer detail owed to the review engineer first.
The Highfield Village cluster subdivision hearing was continued to March 28 so traffic answers and a zoning question on open space can be resolved.
The planner is to consult the building inspector or zoning officer on whether the open space requirement can be waived, and to write a memo on its history.
The board agreed in principle to try an extra workshop meeting on bylaws, with timing still to be worked out.

why_it_matters: The Highfield Village open space question decides whether a cluster subdivision can proceed under the bylaw as written, which affects density, neighboring land and traffic on Route 13.
The Unitil stormwater and barrier details bear on runoff and fuel containment at a utility site on Electric Avenue, and both stay open until March 14.
watch_next: March 14: Unitil 357 Electric Avenue hearing resumes, after the petrol barrier detail is supplied.
March 28: Highfield Village hearing resumes, with traffic answers and the planner's open space memo.
